prior_report.status: Original scratch JSON and the two temporary generators were lost on remount. This is a new report recomputed from Git objects.

columns: distinct resolved module names, including targets
names with multiple distinct source digests
names with only attachment or archive bytes
method.scope: Representative terminal source paths are pinned independently per board row. Follow explicit ImbalancedChen imports only. Ignore Mathlib and other upstream packages; alternative candidate combinations are not traversed. Counts are unions per leaf.
method.selection: Pin each terminal to its registered source-only path. For its dependencies prefer the production path ImbalancedChen/<module>.lean, then the source hash in Y04, then tracked Lean, tracked .lean.txt, named archive member or digest-matched opaque source payload. Shorter path then lexical order break ties. Retain different digest candidates even when a preferred version is available.
method.source_checks: Use git ls-tree -rz and git cat-file --batch at the two commits. Search .lean/.lean.txt and ZIP/tar sources, including .reused and __<sha256> member names; recognize base64 archives. Attach registry-linked, exact-checksummed .raw or decoded gzip sources. For missing sources compare registered hashes against all raw Git blobs and all decoded archive members irrespective of filename.
method.prior_missing_name_check: The lost report also checked missing names in tracked JSON, Markdown, text, TSV, SHA lists, JSONL, patches and diffs. This reconstruction records hash registries and source-byte lookups, without reproducing that ancillary text-reference index.
method.limitations: A dependency selected by this static rule may be incompatible with its callers. A digest match establishes byte identity only. Neither compilation, kernel replay nor axiom checks are part of this audit. The remote lookup covers the pinned tree and its archive bytes, not prior revisions.
